     def equals(self, other: Any) -> bool:
         return self.func(other)

+class IsMac(DirtyEquals[str]):
+    """
+    A class that checks if a value is a valid MAC address, optionally checking the format.
+    """
+
+    _patterns = {
+        'colon': re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{2}(?::[0-9a-f]{2}){5}', re.IGNORECASE),
+        'hyphen': re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{2}(?:-[0-9a-f]{2}){5}', re.IGNORECASE),
+        'dot': re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{4}(?:\.[0-9a-f]{4}){2}', re.IGNORECASE),
+        'compact': re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{12}', re.IGNORECASE),
+    }
+
+    def __init__(self, format: Literal[None, 'colon', 'hyphen', 'dot', 'compact'] = None):
+        """
+        Args:
+            format: The format of the MAC address to check, if omitted, all formats are accepted.
+                - `'colon'`: colon-separated format, e.g. `'00:1B:44:11:3A:B7'`
+                - `'hyphen'`: hyphen-separated format, e.g. `'00-1B-44-11-3A-B7'`
+                - `'dot'`: dot-separated format, e.g. `'001B.4411.3AB7'`
+                - `'compact'`: compact format without separators, e.g. `'001b44113ab7'`
+
+        ```py title="IsMac"
+        from dirty_equals import IsMac
+
+        assert '00:1B:44:11:3A:B7' == IsMac
+        assert '00-1B-44-11-3A-B7' == IsMac
+        assert '001B.4411.3AB7' == IsMac
+        assert '001b44113ab7' == IsMac
+        assert '00:1B:44:11:3A:B7' == IsMac('colon')
+        assert '00-1B-44-11-3A-B7' == IsMac('hyphen')
+        assert '001B.4411.3AB7' == IsMac('dot')
+        assert '001b44113ab7' == IsMac('compact')
+        assert '00:1B:44:11:3A:B7' != IsMac('hyphen')
+        assert '00:1B:44:11:3A' != IsMac
+        ```
+        """
+        self.format = format
+        super().__init__(format or plain_repr('*'))
+
+    def equals(self, other: Any) -> bool:
+        if not isinstance(other, str):
+            return False
+        if self.format is not None:
+            pattern = self._patterns.get(self.format)
+            return pattern is not None and pattern.fullmatch(other) is not None
+        return any(p.fullmatch(other) is not None for p in self._patterns.values())
+
+
+class IsEmail(DirtyEquals[str]):
+    """
+    A class that checks if a value is a valid email address, optionally checking the domain.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, domain: Optional[str] = None):
+        """
+        Args:
+            domain: The domain to check, if omitted, any domain is accepted. Comparison is case-sensitive.
+
+        ```py title="IsEmail"
+        from dirty_equals import IsEmail
+
+        assert 'foo@example.com' == IsEmail
+        assert 'foo@example.com' == IsEmail(domain='example.com')
+        assert 'foo@other.com' != IsEmail(domain='example.com')
+        assert 'foo@Example.com' != IsEmail(domain='example.com')
+        assert 'not an email' != IsEmail
+        ```
+        """
+        self.domain = domain
+        super().__init__(plain_repr('*') if domain is None else domain)
+
+    def equals(self, other: Any) -> bool:
+        if not isinstance(other, str):
+            return False
+        m = _email_regex.fullmatch(other)
+        if m is None:
+            return False
+        if self.domain is not None:
+            return m.group(1) == self.domain
+        return True
+
+
+_email_regex = re.compile(
+    r"[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@((?:[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,})"
+)
